BiblicalUsage: Jerusha is an Israelitess, the mother of Jotham king of Judah. In 2 Kings 15:33, he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. The fuller story is told on the Jerusha, Mother of Jotham profile in Biblical People.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jerusha belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
